title: '22 built-in agents' model is obsolete — base engine ships zero agents
reality: v2.3.0 moved all optional agents into downloadable packages and removed 25,000+ lines of agent/map/call/table-game code from the base Engine. Verified upstream: BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS in packages/shared/src/features/agents/agent-registry.generated.ts is now an EMPTY array; BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS survives only as legacy/compatibility ids (21 entries, about-me-keeper removed). Fresh installs contain NO optional agents; existing installs migrate selections/settings/history.
fix: Rewrite agents.md 'Built-In Agents' as 'Official Downloadable Agents': drop the 22-count and the BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS counting instruction; keep per-agent descriptions but mark each as an installable package; intro becomes the two-step model — install from Download Agents, then enable per chat.

title: about-me-keeper retired; About Me / update_about_me stays Engine-native
reality: Verified upstream: 'about-me-keeper' moved to RETIRED_BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS. Per 2.3.0, Conversation's About Me profile and update_about_me tool remain built into the Engine and are NOT downloadable agents; per 2.3.2 About Me drafting moved to Professor Mari.
fix: Remove the about-me-keeper entry from the agent list, add it to the retired list, and note About Me/update_about_me is a built-in Engine feature drafted via Mari.

title: Download Agents library undocumented
reality: v2.3.0 added a full-page Agents → Download Agents library (install/read-about/update/uninstall official capability packages; installed/uninstalled groupings ordered Writer, Tracker, Misc; creator artwork with star fallback; Install All / Uninstall All via a safe sequential queue). 2.3.2 (#3676) added Conversation/Roleplay/Game compatibility badges and catalog search by mode.
fix: Add a 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' top-level section to agents.md covering the library, groupings, bulk controls, badges, fresh-install-empty behavior, and migration.

title: Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents 29-package catalog missing
reality: v2.3.0 published first-party agents in github.com/Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents as individually verified packages: 29 packages — 6 Writer (card-evolution-auditor, continuity, knowledge-retrieval, knowledge-router, director, prose-guardian), 8 Tracker (background, character-tracker, custom-tracker, expression, hierarchical-maps, persona-stats, quest, world-state), 15 Misc (eightball, chess, combat, conversation-calls, cyoa, echo-chamber, haptic, illustrator, html, lorebook-keeper, spotify/Music DJ, poker, rock-paper-scissors, tic-tac-toe, uno). Trust model: schema validation, SHA-256 checksums, per-file hash/size checks, atomic install, offline availability. Mari's prompts carry the canonical 29-package summary. Upstream reference doc: docs/agents/built-in-agents.md.
fix: Add a 'Package catalog' subsection to agents.md with the repo, the 6/8/15 breakdown, package ids mapped to old built-in ids, the trust model, and the upstream reference doc.

title: Enable Agents master toggle semantics undocumented
reality: Each chat has an 'Enable Agents' master switch gating all agent initialization and model calls. Preserved across the v2.3 capability migration (#3669); 2.3.3 made Hierarchical Maps fully obey it (UI, prompt generation, lorebook previews, retries, tracker patches, carryover, checkpoints).
fix: Add an 'Enable Agents master toggle' note to agents.md: per-chat switch, off = no selected agent (including package services) initializes or calls a model; survives upgrades without re-enabling.

title: Custom agents now run in all three modes (mode gating stale)
reality: 2.3.2 (#3692): selected custom agents run in Conversation, Roleplay, AND Game whenever Enable Agents is on; per-mode availability rules apply only to official packages (surfaced as compatibility badges in Download Agents).
fix: Update agents.md 'Game Mode & mode gating': custom agents are mode-universal under Enable Agents; modeAllowlist-style gating applies to official packages only.

title: Hierarchical Maps package undocumented
reality: Hierarchical Maps is a downloadable Tracker Agent package (v2.3.0), enableable in Roleplay and during/after Game creation; controls nested inside its Chat Settings → Agents entry (2.3.2 #3679). 2.3.3: obeys Enable Agents; incompatible 1.0.x runtimes quarantined (fixes 't.select is not a function'); #3723 one-time correction removes the 2.3.2 migration's accidental Maps auto-selection; inactive-chat Maps calls no longer block sends ('Failed to flush 1 game-state patch callback').
fix: Add a Hierarchical Maps entry (Tracker) to agents.md with availability, settings location, Enable Agents gating, and the 2.3.3 quarantine/migration-correction troubleshooting notes.

title: Calls package (renamed from Conversation Calls) undocumented in agents.md
reality: 2.3.0 moved audio/video calls into the conversation-calls package; 2.3.2 (#3676) renamed user-facing references to 'Calls' (package IDs preserved). Local Whisper is Calls-owned: Connections shows Local Speech Model controls only while installed; uninstall removes downloaded Whisper models. #3671 fixed Whisper discovery when DATA_DIR unset; package v1.0.4 (#3685) stopped hardcoded fallback replies and dropped the provider-native JSON mode requirement.
fix: Add a 'Calls' entry (Misc, id conversation-calls) noting the rename, package status, and Whisper ownership.

title: Six table games are Conversation feature packages, not pipeline agents
reality: UNO, Chess, Poker, 8-Ball Pool, Tic-Tac-Toe, Rock-Paper-Scissors are optional packages with package-owned runtimes (2.3.0). They surface as Commands toggles (no Add Agent entries, no legacy activeAgentIds), and installed games hot-activate slash commands without an Engine restart (2.3.2 #3699); route-bearing packages keep a safe restart path.
fix: Document the six game packages in agents.md as command/surface packages with the no-restart activation distinction.

title: Illustrator is an install-gated package (commands, Gallery, renames)
reality: Illustrator is a downloadable Misc package (2.3.0). Until installed+enabled per chat: /illustrate and /selfie are hidden, image/video generation settings are hidden, and Gallery Illustrate/Selfie/Storyboard/Video/Animate/Background actions are unavailable in every mode. Renames: selfie configuration → 'Illustrator Settings' (Chat Settings → Agents); Connections defaults category 'Illustrator' → 'Images'; Game setup 'Visual Generation' → Illustrator.
fix: Update the illustrator entry in agents.md with package status, gating behavior, and the three renames.

title: Music DJ (spotify) is an install-gated package; Game Assets is a third source
reality: Music DJ is a downloadable Misc package (id 'spotify'). The always-available Music Player toggle shows 'Download Music DJ Agent to configure' guidance when it isn't installed (2.3.0). Catalog: plays scene-matched music through Spotify, YouTube, or local Game Assets.
fix: Update the spotify entry: package status, Music Player download guidance, and the Game Assets source.

title: Package lifecycle: startup auto-upgrade, offline fallback, rollback, quarantine
reality: 2.3.1: installed packages check the catalog at server startup and auto-upgrade to the newest compatible version before runtimes activate; offline/incompatible/missing/failed updates keep the previous version; verified runtime failures roll back automatically. 2.3.2 (#3706/#3707): catalog HTTP failures report real status; installed agents work offline. Incompatible versions are quarantined before their hooks can crash generation (#3647, 2.3.3).
fix: Add a 'Package lifecycle' subsection to agents.md.

title: Per-Engine-major catalog lanes undocumented
reality: 2.3.3 (#3712): each Engine major installs/updates only from its matching catalog lane — catalog/v2/catalog.json for Engine 2, catalog/v3/ for Engine 3, catalog/catalog.json as legacy v2 alias.
fix: Note the lanes in the package-catalog section of agents.md.

title: Capability API 1.3 host services undocumented
reality: 2.3.2 (#3690) added capability API 1.3 host services for packages: safe model routing, persistence, history/checkpoints, resources, logging, transactions, client contribution loading, visible readiness/retry states. Base Engine exposes validated capability registries and compatibility bridges; capability-owned tables resolve via registered schema names (#3647).
fix: Add a short 'Capability API (packages)' subsection to agents.md for package authors/debuggers.

title: Source-of-truth pointers stale after the package split
reality: Engine paths (agent-executor.ts, agent-pipeline.ts, agent.schema.ts, agent-prompts.ts) still exist, but packaged-agent feature code lives in Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Agents (packages/<id>/), agent-registry.generated.ts's manifest list is empty, and BuiltInAgentMeta gained category ('writer'|'tracker'|'misc') and execution ('pipeline'|'feature') fields.
fix: Update agents.md source-of-truth line: keep executor/pipeline/schema paths, add the Marinara-Agents repo and docs/agents/built-in-agents.md, drop the counting instruction, mention the new manifest fields.

title: UI Location section predates the package model
reality: The Agents sidebar now lists installed packages (catalog artwork, star fallback) plus the Download Agents entry point; uninstall refreshes the open sidebar immediately. Chat Settings → Agents stays available in all three modes even with nothing installed; empty sections and the empty setup-wizard Agents step link to Download Agents; built-in Conversation commands remain configurable without downloads.
fix: Rewrite agents.md 'UI Location' accordingly.

title: v2.3 migration behavior worth a note
reality: Upgrades from ≤2.2 migrate agents and chat feature selections without losing settings/data/history; migration is restart-safe/idempotent (#3670). Known bug: the 2.3.2 migration auto-selected Hierarchical Maps everywhere; 2.3.3 (#3723) ships a one-time correction.
fix: Add a brief 'Upgrading to v2.3' note to agents.md.

title: Downloadable Agents / capability-package system missing
reality: v2.3.0 restructured the engine around downloadable capability packages: Download Agents library, Marinara-Agents 29-package catalog, Maps/Calls/six table games moved to packages with package-owned server runtimes, 25,000+ lines removed from base (capability registries + compatibility bridges remain), fresh installs ship no optional agents, existing installs migrate. 2.3.1 startup auto-upgrade with rollback; 2.3.2 capability API 1.3 (#3690) + mode badges (#3676); 2.3.3 per-major catalog lanes (#3712).
fix: Add a 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' section to architecture.md and update the big-picture framing.

title: Agent core-object entry still says '22 built-ins'
reality: Optional agents install from the 29-package catalog (Writer/Tracker/Misc); fresh installs contain none; custom agents run in Conversation/Roleplay/Game whenever Enable Agents is on (2.3.2 #3692).
fix: Rewrite the Agent core-object blurb to the v2.3 package model and document the per-chat Enable Agents master toggle.

title: Storage section documents removed SQLite backend / DATABASE_URL import
reality: v2.3.0 removed the retired database compatibility stack (runtime backend switch, startup migrations, importer/repair readers, migration scripts, DB-file backup handling, external ORM deps). Storage is file-native throughout with enforceable primary/natural-key constraints; graceful-shutdown flush hardened (#3602); native profile imports atomic (#3683, 2.3.2); packages resolve schemas by registered name (#3647).

Distinct from the downloadable combat agent package.
fix: Add a 'Tactical Combat (v2.3)' paragraph to the Game Mode section.

title: Game setup export is a versioned .marinara-game-setup.json bundle, not .txt
reality: 2.3.2 (#3701): Initial Game Setup downloads produce versioned .marinara-game-setup.json bundles that refill the New Game wizard, remap local resources, warn about missing ones, and require a replacement GM connection when necessary. title: Hierarchical Maps not documented
